differences.title: 1. DATABASE MIGRATIONS
differences.leftDesc: Prisma includes a dedicated migration engine for managing schema changes, allowing schema evolution and rollback through its CLI. It generates SQL diffs.
differences.rightDesc: Kysely is a query builder and doesn't manage migrations itself, relying on separate tools like `node-pg-migrate` or custom scripts for schema management.

differences.title: 2. SCHEMA DEFINITION
differences.leftDesc: Prisma uses a declarative Prisma Schema Language (.prisma) to define models, then generates a type-safe client from it for application interaction.
differences.rightDesc: Kysely defines schemas directly in TypeScript, inferring types from JavaScript objects or SQL column definitions, promoting a code-first approach.

differences.title: 3. QUERYING STYLE
differences.leftDesc: Prisma offers a fluent, method-chaining API that abstracts SQL, providing a high-level ORM experience for common database operations.
differences.rightDesc: Kysely provides a type-safe builder that closely mirrors SQL syntax, allowing for expressive and complex queries with strong compile-time checks.

differences.title: 4. TYPE SAFETY
differences.leftDesc: Prisma generates a fully type-safe client based on your Prisma Schema, ensuring robust IntelliSense and compile-time checks for all queries.
differences.rightDesc: Kysely infers types from database schemas or explicit TypeScript types, providing excellent type safety for your queries and results.

differences.title: 5. DATABASE SUPPORT
differences.leftDesc: Prisma supports PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite, SQL Server, MongoDB, and CockroachDB, with a consistent API across them.
differences.rightDesc: Kysely supports PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite, and better SQL Server via adapters, offering flexibility in database choices and custom SQL.

differences.title: 6. ADAPTER PATTERN
differences.leftDesc: Prisma abstracts the database connection and query execution logic through its generated client, handling pooling internally.
differences.rightDesc: Kysely uses database-specific drivers (e.g., `pg`, `mysql2`) and can integrate with connection poolers like `generic-pool` for efficient resource management.

differences.title: 7. LEARNING CURVE
differences.leftDesc: Prisma's ORM-like API can be easier for developers new to SQL, but requires learning its specific query patterns.
differences.rightDesc: Kysely is ideal for those comfortable with SQL, as its builder closely maps to SQL concepts, reducing the abstraction barrier.
